purpose: Specify whether the jointly supported MLP6--7 source family is read through MLP8 and attention-11 head-3 as a locally quadratic response or whether RMS normalization and downstream value formation require materially nonlinear finite transport.

binding_evidence.finding: MLP6--7 is the larger member of a distributed MLP4--7 parent while MLP4--5 remains contextually necessary; the pair-level split is number-specific.
MLP6 and MLP7 do not form stable individually selective units: their effects are distributed, interacting, direction-dependent, and one child corner fails lexical specificity. Retain X=MLP6+MLP7.
The exact MLP8 bilinear response is direction-dependent and cancellation-rich; fixed cross/quadratic terms are intervention-live.
The signed MLP8 cross/quadratic response pattern transfers to fronted syntax under reused text.

novelty_audit: No Task14 receipt differentiates endpoint versus midpoint Jacobian transport of an already causal MLP6--7 source through the exact MLP8-to-L11H3 computation.
Earlier MLP0 tangent/quotient work concerns a different module, task, and consumer family and does not answer this finite Task14 response question.
This tests an exact local response map and task-level causal replay; it does not fit a subspace, reduce rank, reconstruct activations, or price compression.
map: For each existing HOLDOUT row and each source in {opposite-number, same-number lexical}, form two X=MLP6+MLP7 paths while retaining all other source families: recipient background compares subset empty to X; donor-context background compares EAUW to EAUWX. Define f(x) as native MLP8 RMSNorm and bilinear MLP, native residual propagation through blocks 9--11, native attention-11 head-3 current-value RMSNorm/c_v/projection with the recipient attention pattern and cached value fixed. Compare exact f(x1)-f(x0) with J_f(x0)(x1-x0) and J_f((x0+x1)/2)(x1-x0), then install exact and predicted head vectors into the native tail.
mathematical_discriminator: For a degree-at-most-two map along the source path, the midpoint directional derivative equals the exact secant. Endpoint error isolates quadratic curvature; residual midpoint error isolates RMS normalization and later nonlinear value formation or higher path curvature.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_parent_closure: All replay/no-op/state/head gates are at most 5e-5, every exact finite arm reproduces its frozen parent Task14 margin and CE effects within 5e-5, and all JVP tensors are finite.
predictions.pred_b_midpoint_quadratic_readout: For opposite-number sources in both backgrounds and all four direction/template cells, midpoint JVP head-delta cosine is at least 0.95, relative error at most 0.25, and installed task-margin recovery is in [0.75,1.25] with the exact sign.
predictions.pred_c_endpoint_local_readout: The same cells satisfy endpoint-JVP cosine at least 0.90 and relative error at most 0.35 with task-margin recovery in [0.65,1.35] and the exact sign.
predictions.pred_d_material_nonquadratic_transport: Prediction b fails and at least one opposite-number midpoint relative error exceeds 0.35 or installed task-margin recovery leaves [0.60,1.40]. This is the opposing account, not a rescue threshold.
predictions.pred_e_context_changes_readout: The mean midpoint relative error differs by at least 0.15 between recipient and donor-context backgrounds in either grammatical direction.
predictions.pred_f_parent_level_lexical_specificity: For exact and midpoint arms, absolute same-number lexical task-margin effects are at most 25% of the matched opposite-number exact effect in every background/cell.

null: If the instrument holds but b--e all fail, the tested endpoint and midpoint tangents do not give a stable computational specification of the finite parent-unit readout. Preserve the exact finite circuit and move to an operational downstream-equivalence test rather than tuning tangent thresholds.
closed_claims: necessity outside the fixed L11H3 interface
